+"""Masked account numbers for lists where the full number is not needed."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+def mask_number(number: str) -> str:
+    """Keep the first group and the last four characters; replace each other letter or digit.
+
+    ``YMS-0000-0001`` becomes ``YMS-****-0001``. Separators stay, so the shape is visible.
+    """
+    first, _, _ = number.partition("-")
+    keep_head = len(first)
+    keep_tail = max(len(number) - 4, keep_head)
+    return "".join(
+        "*" if keep_head <= i < keep_tail and ch.isalnum() else ch for i, ch in enumerate(number)
+    )
